interpretation.es: Una campaña exploratoria de cuatro ensayos (1 minuto medido cada uno) confirmó, mediante las marcas COMMIT independientes de PostgreSQL, 40,0 y 80,0 transacciones por segundo en las rutas directa y Orleans. Se verificaron 14.880 transferencias persistidas, 29.760 asientos, 14.880 eventos outbox y 28/28 oráculos contables. No se observaron admisiones perdidas ni respuestas ambiguas. La prueba corrigió y documentó un error previo de metadatos (7.440 en lugar de 14.880 solicitudes programadas). Los percentiles p99 son descriptivos de un único ensayo por ruta/tasa, no un SLA ni evidencia de superioridad de Orleans. No se ha observado un límite de saturación ni demostrado equivalencia con un mainframe.
interpretation.en: An exploratory four-trial campaign (one minute measured per case) confirmed independently server-recorded PostgreSQL COMMIT rates of 40.0 and 80.0 transactions/s through both direct and Orleans routes. The source artifact verifies 14,880 durable transfers, 29,760 postings, 14,880 outbox events and 28/28 independent accounting oracles. No missed admissions or ambiguous outcomes were observed. A previous metadata-count error (7,440 instead of 14,880 scheduled requests) was explicitly corrected and its original run preserved. The p99 measurements describe only one case per route/rate and do not establish SLA or Orleans superiority. No saturation limit or mainframe equivalence has been demonstrated.

limitations: One physical Linux runner with four separate Podman namespaces; only 40 and 80 offered requests/s, exactly one seeded repetition per route/rate and one 80%-hot-source profile. These observations demonstrate actual server-side SQL COMMIT rates at two bounded load points, NOT sustainable maximum capacity, statistical SLO/p99, physically independent horizontal scaling, distributed clock synchronization, mainframe MIPS throughput equivalence or dated Azure TCO. ACK-only latency percentiles are not reliable when outcomes are censored; even with zero omissions, one trial cannot rank routes. Auxiliary pg_stat_database samples include observer/membership traffic, not only business COMMITs.
